apps.name: PatataTube
apps.subtitle: Self-hosted watch-later for videos.
apps.localizedDescription: PatataTube — a self-hosted watch-later. Browse, classify and play the videos your PatataTube server has downloaded, with offline caching.

versions.localizedDescription:
[DEVLOG] Picture in Picture from the player

• A chevron below the moon sends the video to a floating window
• The float's restore button reopens the player where you left off

Instrumented build — posts runtime logs to the PatataTube backend.

Force horizontal replaces the old orientation lock

• The player's lock button now forces the video to landscape instead of just freezing whatever way you're holding the phone
• Turn it on and the video stays landscape through a 180° flip and through auto-advancing to the next video
• Turn it off to return to normal rotation

Search bar stays put while you scroll

• The search field is pinned to the top instead of scrolling out of view

Paused downloads now pick up right where they left off

• Resuming a paused download continues from the saved point instead of starting over
• Fixed an edge case that could corrupt a download's saved progress

What's new in 2.0.10:

• chore(ios): drop unrelated Package.resolved churn from the fix wave
• fix(ios): close permit leak and pause races found in final review
• docs: describe pausable downloads
• feat(ios): wire pause/resume from the downloads menu to the cache
• feat(ios): move cancel into a per-download menu with pause/resume
• feat(ios): keep paused downloads paused across foreground and launch
• feat(ios): resume a paused download on its held permit
• feat(ios): pause a download without discarding its partial bytes

Maintenance rebuild

• No user-facing changes since 2.0.8

[DEVLOG] Downloads speed readout now reports real throughput

• The In Progress header no longer sits at 0.0 MB/s while downloads run
• Instrumented build: posts download diagnostics to the server log

Instrumented build — posts runtime logs to the PatataTube backend.

See how fast your downloads are moving

• The Downloads tab now shows a live speed readout (e.g. 12.4 MB/s) next to "In Progress"
• The rate is a smooth 5-second average across everything downloading at once
• It stays accurate as individual downloads finish, and disappears once the queue is empty

Video Info fields are now tap-to-copy

• Tap any field in Video Info to copy its value to the clipboard
• The tapped row confirms with a green Copied check and a haptic tap

Videos you play now download themselves once conversion finishes

• Tapping play on an unconverted movie or episode starts its download automatically as soon as the server finishes converting
• The download still happens if the app was closed and reopened while converting

What's new in 2.0.4:

• fix(jobs): free versions stuck converting with no job; add download gate instrumentation
• perf: raise default FFMPEG_JOB_LIMIT to 2
• fix(ios): repair the app target's test build and green the suite
• docs: record the pre-existing PlayerViewControllerTests build break
• refactor(ios): share one options menu across list and detail views
• fix: stop macOS EXC_GUARD worker kills from post-fork setproctitle
• docs: track docs/ directory in git
• fix: document post-deploy scan requirement and clear stale subtitle_lang on version switch

[DEVLOG] Diagnostic build for the stuck download bug

• Movies stuck on Converting forever are freed and can be downloaded again
• This build records download and conversion diagnostics to help track down downloads that stall before they start

Instrumented build — posts runtime logs to the PatataTube backend.

What's new in 2.0.2:

• perf: raise default FFMPEG_JOB_LIMIT to 2
• fix(ios): repair the app target's test build and green the suite
• docs: record the pre-existing PlayerViewControllerTests build break
• refactor(ios): share one options menu across list and detail views
• fix: stop macOS EXC_GUARD worker kills from post-fork setproctitle
• docs: track docs/ directory in git
• fix: document post-deploy scan requirement and clear stale subtitle_lang on version switch
• fix: address final review findings (doc accuracy, a11y label, dedup duration helper, deterministic Popen cleanup)

Movie pages get the full options menu

• Movie detail now carries the same menu as the lists: New video, Autoplay, Randomize, Downloads, Delete cached and Settings
• Two videos convert at once, so downloads finish sooner

Movies and shows can now play with the right subtitles

• Pick a subtitle language per movie from the info screen — it sticks, no re-conversion needed
• Downloads view now shows what's actively converting, with live percent on the download button
• Download-all queues behind whatever you tap interactively, so it never hogs the converter

The cover picker preselects the current emoji

• Opening Choose cover highlights the emoji already set, so the next one you tap replaces it instead of piling on

The cover picker opens on the emoji keyboard

• Choosing a group cover comes up on the emoji keyboard instead of the letter keyboard
• Renaming a group is back to the normal keyboard

Renaming a group opens the emoji keyboard

• The rename field now comes up on the emoji keyboard, so a cover emoji is one tap away

Open Web shortcut lands on the web bridge

• The Open Web home-screen shortcut no longer flashes back into last session's tab, list or player
• That session restores when you tap the back button in the web bridge

Download all knows when it's done

• Download all in the grid menu greys out once every video on screen is already downloaded

Grid size menu stays open while resizing

• Tapping bigger/smaller cells no longer closes the menu, so repeated taps work in one go

Grid pinch-to-resize now feels like Photos

• Two fingers down stops scrolling instantly and resizes the grid live
• Release snaps to the nearest grid size and remembers it next time you open the app

Resize the grid with a pinch

• Pinch anywhere over a group or the Movies tab to live-resize the grid
• Release snaps to the nearest size, same stops as the size menu
• Pinch small enough and it switches into list view

Grid size steps are bigger, fewer, and actually visible

• Shrink/grow-cells in the ⋯ menu now jumps between 3 sizes that look different on iPhone, instead of 6 steps where several looked identical

Grid size menu no longer has a dead step

• Shrinking/growing grid cells in the ⋯ menu no longer has a click that visibly does nothing right before switching to list view

What's new in 1.4.1:

• feat(ios): row-shaped loading skeleton in list mode
• feat(ios): render movies as rows in list mode
• feat(ios): render videos as rows in list mode
• feat(ios): drive grid columns and size menu from GridDisplayMode
• feat(ios): add GridDisplayMode size/mode state machine
• feat(ios): add rename group to ellipsis menu
• fix: close the gaps left by the video-groups plan
• fix: clear loading after group move

Groups can now be renamed

• Ellipsis menu on a group card gets a Rename option

Video groups now live on the server

• Add a group on the server and it appears on the iPad — the list is no longer baked into the app
• Group covers came along: each group keeps its emoji, editable from the card's ⋯ menu
• TV and Movies are a separate axis from groups, with their own tabs
• A video's ⋯ menu lists the groups, plus its own Move to Plex section
• Switching tabs while a group move is in flight no longer leaves cards duplicated or missing

Group covers stop flashing a video frame

• Group cards no longer flash the last video's preview before the emoji cover appears
• A group without a cover shows a plain placeholder instead of borrowing art from a video

Episode lists get the same menu as groups

• One ⋯ menu in a TV show replaces the separate autoplay and download buttons
• Autoplay and Randomize now apply to the show you are watching, not to every show at once
• Download all in a show still queues only that show's episodes

Group screens get their own menu and their own settings

• The ⋯ menu now sits next to Back inside a video group, instead of disappearing when you open one
• Download all only queues the group you are looking at
• Autoplay, Randomize and cell size are remembered per group

Easier to hit the group card menu

• The ⋯ button on each group card is bigger and easier to tap
• Taps near the button no longer open the group by mistake

Pick an emoji cover for each video group

• Each group card has a ⋯ menu with Choose cover — type one emoji and it becomes the card's art
• Covers are saved on the server, so the same emoji shows up on every device
• Remove cover puts the automatic poster art back

Fixes group card artwork

• Group card posters stay inside their tile instead of spilling across the grid

Videos, TV and Movies are now tabs

• A tab bar replaces the old segmented category picker
• The Videos tab opens on four group cards - Children, Adults, Anabel and ASMR - each with its own grid
• New ASMR category
• Group cards show the newest video's poster and keep showing it offline
• Each tab keeps its own scroll position and reopens where you left off after a force-quit
